description:
module :maps lacked put, merge and from_list. json.erl calls maps:merge (l.648) and maps:from_list (l.930, 1438, 1474); maps:to_list (l.291) plus keys and values are already on develop from fz-mue.59 (#896, 66bfc7f89). Reproducers: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/15_maps_fold_put_merge.fz (minus fold), 16_maps_from_list_to_list.fz.

Part of fz-mue (fz runs OTP's json.erl unchanged). Port and harness: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/. Pages: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-mue.7.html; the scope below follows the plan the user approved on the fz-mue.59 page (relayed by Optimize, 2026-11-24). Earlier decisions (user, 2026-11-20): split at the improper-list line, so iterator/next/fold are fz-mue.55 (after fz-sc8.22.2) and ordered iterators are fz-mue.56; an iterator's position is fz's entry index.

Owner: Optimize. Builds on fz-sc8.192.3 and fz-mue.59 (#896). Branch fz-mue.7/maps-on-develop in ../fz-mue7.

Out of scope (moved by the approved plan): :erts_internal.map_next/3 waits for fz-mue.55, and :maps.to_list stays over its private walk.

This ticket:
- :maps.put/3, merge/2 and from_list/1 over the existing fz_map_put and fz_map_from_kv. Map.put, Map.merge and Map.new delegate to them, and each raises BadMapError where OTP raises {badmap, X}.
- Map.merge's rebuild through build(to_list(a) ++ to_list(b)) becomes :maps.merge (cost unchanged; a one-pass runtime merge is a separate proposal with its own probe).
- Punch 15 (minus fold) and 16 become oracle fixture 01926 in the fz-mue block.
- Docs: .agent/docs/modules.md, any-value.md, fixtures.md.
Erlang-module pattern: lib/lists.fz (defmodule :lists, registered in src/modules/runtime_library.rs).
